Prominent recognizable Xbox 360 green-and-silver sphere with its deep X groove integrated behind the head; ocular mechanical device becomes a four-segment luminous green Xbox power ring. Small grey controller ABXY colored buttons; elegant curved silver dashboard blades frame the lower neck. Strong authentic Xbox silhouette, not generic green sci-fi.

Restrained authentic period-specific material highlights, no photorealism, no busy gradients on every surface, no glossy AI esports shield. Incorporate the requested genuine brand marks visibly and recognizably as real design elements, not generic approximations. The whole logo is a cohesive compact silhouette and artwork, not a full scene or an asset sheet.
